
#1 Destruction


Chapter 1: World Destruction

Su Mo stood expressionless within his Little Universe, holding a handful of soil and letting it scatter from above.

In an instant, it transformed into an endless meteor shower, smashing toward that azure planet.

Every grain of dust was like a massive meteorite, carrying boundless might and burning with raging flames as they crashed onto the planet.

Like terrifying mushroom clouds detonating simultaneously, the earth shook, and dust billowed tens of thousands of feet high, blotting out the sun!

On the azure planet, countless ordinary people watched the terrifying meteor shower in the sky, their faces drained of color.

Some knelt on the ground praying to gods and Buddhas, while others cursed loudly, shouting about the injustice of heaven and earth.

The earth shattered, mountains collapsed, and seawater surged inland; countless lives perished in an instant.

A civilization was destroyed by the soil he had casually tossed.

Su Mo watched silently, and after confirming that the planet had been hit by a comprehensive strike, he snapped his fingers.

The next moment, time seemed to be put on fast-forward; in just a few moments, the receding seawater flowed back into the oceans, and the deep craters left by the meteorites were covered again by the settling dust.

Some craters were filled with seawater, becoming massive lakes and lake clusters, but all life upon them had vanished.

A surge of energy rushed into Su Mo's body, and he looked down at the simple system panel he had fashioned using his god of creation.

Gender: Male

god rank: 3.49 (Current World god rank: 3.14)

Creation Level: 1

"My god rank has reached 3.49. With just one more world destruction, I can break through to 3.5. At 3.5, I should be able to use some supernatural abilities even in this ordinary, magic-less world."

After thinking for a moment, Su Mo snapped back to reality and clicked the system's simple one-click creation template.

He then exited the Little Universe, appearing in a small farmhouse courtyard. He walked over to a lounge chair, slowly lay down, and fell back into thought.

It had been ten days since he obtained this god of creation. In these ten days, aside from the first three spent researching how to use it after quitting his job, he had destroyed worlds seven times in a row—roughly once a day.

Under normal circumstances, a creation system should grow stronger by constantly creating worlds, and that was what Su Mo had originally thought.

However, after reading the message left by the previous host, he chose to prioritize increasing his god rank.

The higher the god rank, the higher the level of worlds one could visit. Both are creation gods, but a God of Creation from a world of 'Mommy's Entanglement' is simply incomparable to a God of Creation from a Primordial World.

As for why he didn't raise his God of Creation level before increasing his god rank, the reason was simple: the higher the divinity level, the harder it is to increase one's god rank.

The previous host of the god of creation had raised their level to nine, only to be killed by two punches from an ordinary person in a higher world—all because their god rank was too low.

Increasing god rank was also simple: world destruction. By gathering the god rank of an entire civilization unto oneself, one's god rank would rise.

This was extremely difficult for others, but for Su Mo, who possessed the creation system, it was the easiest thing in the world.

So, lately, he had been constantly creating, destroying, destroying, and creating in a cycle.

Aside from the time spent completing a destruction and restarting a creation, Su Mo set the time ratio to one day per thousand years.

In the early stages of creating a world, because he had to wipe away the traces of the past, he set it to one day per hundred thousand years.

In the blink of an eye since he stepped out, over a thousand years had already passed.

At this point, the simple system Su Mo built with the god of creation would randomly deploy ordinary civilization seeds and then control the time at a ratio of one day per thousand years.

It wasn't that Su Mo was unwilling to wait longer, but rather that a thousand years was the optimal timeframe.

In a thousand years, even the lowest level of civilization, as long as it possessed intelligence, would be enough to reach Level 0.5—roughly equivalent to ancient Earth society.

Furthermore, even if he kept waiting, these civilizations rarely had the chance to reach Level 1.

So, rather than waiting, it was faster to just destroy them at the thousand-year mark.

Su Mo lay on the lounge chair, scrolled through some short videos for a while, and then slowly drifted off to sleep.

Sleepy in spring, tired in summer, and dozing in autumn; in the blink of an eye, it was already afternoon.

Inside the Little Universe, not only had a new civilization appeared, but three hundred years had already passed.

This time, the civilization consisted of New Humans with red-and-white skin, a pair of bull horns, and three eyes.

Their third eye could be used to transmit information. Precisely because of this third eye, they had no lies or deception; everyone could communicate rapidly to develop their civilization together.

Thus, in just three hundred years, they had developed into the steam age.

Such a development speed would be considered absurd in any civilization.

But on second thought, they possessed full intelligence from the moment they appeared, skipping the evolutionary process. If they didn't take any wrong turns and the entire civilization cooperated, reaching the steam age in three hundred years wasn't actually that outrageous.

In the Little Universe, New Humans with three eyes were running through the streets, holding newspapers and shouting: "Breaking news! Breaking news! Another archaeology professor has committed suicide after studying the Ominous Stone Tablet! Don't miss out!"

The surrounding crowds stopped their work upon hearing the news, stepping forward while conversing.

"That's already the seventh archaeology professor to commit suicide while studying that Ominous Stone Tablet. Sigh, I don't know what these professors are so obsessed with. Is it absolutely necessary to study that tablet?"

"Yeah, if the tablet is so ominous, why study it at all?"

"Actually, King Otto said before that he wanted to seal the tablet away permanently, but those archaeology professors refused. They each insisted on studying it, and even King Otto couldn't do anything about them."

"Remember two months ago when Professor Bei Qi confidently told the King that only cowards are afraid to face history and that he would definitely find the truth of the tablet? Well, look at him now, after only a few days."

...

In the capital, at Professor Bei Qi's residence, a New Human lay on his back on the floor. In his hand, he clutched the third eye from between his brows, and his remaining two eyes were filled with madness and disbelief.

But by now, he had completely lost his life.

Nearby, a large group of guards searched the room incessantly. The guards who had been responsible for Professor Bei Qi's safety were being interrogated repeatedly about what had happened last night.

"It is confirmed to be suicide. Based on the traces at the scene, Professor Bei Qi gouged out his Eye of the Soul at three in the morning and chose to end his life.

We found many notes left by Professor Bei Qi nearby. Just like the other professors, he wrote a great deal, but in the end, it was all destroyed. Judging by the traces, he destroyed it all himself.

Therefore, we can conclude that Professor Bei Qi, like the other archaeology professors, succeeded in translating the tablet but ultimately chose suicide to conceal the truth."

After hearing this, King Otto slowly spoke to the guards beside him, asking, "Do you think there truly is such a thing as 'ominous' in this world?"



#2 The Tablet of Destiny


Chapter 2: Tablet of Destiny

Chapter 2

The guard lowered his head: "Your Majesty, I do not know."

King Otto didn't expect the other party to say anything. He just slowly closed his three eyes and spoke indifferently:

"The tablet is just a carrier; what matters is the text on it. The purpose of text is to convey information!"

At this point, his three eyes opened once more, flashing with a terrifying light: "So, what kind of information could make seven archaeological experts choose to commit suicide one after another after translating it! What on earth is recorded on this!

"I used to think our lives were more important than information passed down from ancient times, so I wanted to seal this tablet away. But now it seems I may have been wrong."

"Issue an immediate order to summon all archaeological experts and paleographers worldwide to the Capital!"

"One person cannot bear the weight of this information. I refuse to believe that this many people still won't be enough!"

With King Otto's order issued, archaeological experts from all over the world rushed to the Capital to begin studying this tablet, which was said to be ominous.

Rubbings of the tablet were made and sent to every expert. People followed them twenty-four hours a day to ensure their safety.

Furthermore, they had to meet in the largest laboratory every day to share their research and findings.

With the combined efforts of all the archaeological experts in the country, the information on the tablet was deciphered in just three days.

However, when they looked at the information they had deciphered from the tablet, everyone fell into silence.

【solar calendar Year 730: We discovered a large number of ruins in the ocean. My King deeply felt the fragility of civilization and ordered the creation of record tablets. Even if our civilization disappears in the future, this tablet can prove we once existed.

Although the previous civilization has vanished, my King's benevolence led him to record the information we obtained about that civilization.

The previous civilization is temporarily named the Peking Man, and it was ultimately destroyed by a meteor shower unseen for a thousand years... It ultimately lasted for a thousand years. (Renovated by the Fifth Civilization, renovated by the Sixth Civilization, rubbing renovated by the Seventh Civilization. Below is the original record of the life habits, civilization, and culture of the Second Civilization.)】

【Earth Calendar Year 670: My King saw this tablet and left these words, feeling even more regret for the solar calendar civilization, which actually encountered a great flood unseen for a thousand years... It ultimately lasted for a thousand years. We, the Earth Clan... (Renovated by the Fifth Civilization, renovated by the Sixth Civilization, rubbing renovated by the Seventh Civilization. Below is the original record of the life habits, civilization, and culture of the Third Civilization.)】

【Yama Calendar Year 1002: Our Puluomi Clan obtained this Tablet of Destiny in the year 103 of the Great Sun Calendar, but the King saw it as ominous and sealed it away. It has been nine hundred years since then.

Today, a flood has descended from the heavens, and all things are shattered. At the brink of life and death, reflecting on the first three civilizations on the tablet, how similar they are.

In reality, the First Civilization encountered a meteor shower unseen for a thousand years, the Second Civilization encountered a great flood unseen for a thousand years, the Third Civilization faced another meteor shower, and now our Yama Civilization faces a flood. Future generations (Renovated by the Fifth Civilization, renovated by the Sixth Civilization, rubbing renovated by the Seventh Civilization. No further records below.)】

【Fifth Civilization, New Solar Calendar Year 902: It was already too late when we discovered this tablet. Nine hundred years had already passed. After we translated the information on it and conducted sixty years of research, we reached a conclusion: civilization cycles every thousand years!

Of course, if we still have records in a thousand years, then we were wrong.

If there is no more information hereafter, I also hope to warn future generations: civilization cycles every thousand years. Meteor shower, flood, meteor shower, flood, meteor shower!】

【Sixth Civilization, firestone calendar Year 190: The Fifth Civilization left behind a large number of tablets. Even under the destructive blow of the meteor shower, we still managed to find many of them.

Upon seeing the information on these tablets, our civilization fell into chaos. Countless people could not accept the fact that civilization is destroyed every thousand years, and many ordinary people chose to commit suicide.

firestone calendar Year 389: After two hundred years of chaos, our civilization has once again become stable. My King is governing with diligence, and all the people are united. We believe that as long as we are of one heart, even the flood seven hundred years from now will not be able to destroy us!】

【firestone calendar Year 509: We know that we are about to face a great flood from the heavens, so we have changed our living habits and moved from the basins to the plateaus.

We have dug 327 rivers and countless reservoirs. We will continue such projects. We will surely overcome the great flood five hundred years from now!】

【firestone calendar Year 802: We have used the excavated soil once again to build up the plateaus even better. We even built our houses directly inside caves to resist the great flood from the heavens washing them away.】

【firestone calendar Year 970: We Firestone People are of one heart. The great flood will arrive in thirty years. Although we believe we will succeed, we still want to leave behind our history!

This may also be the final history left by our civilization! (Repaired, rubbed, and copied version by the Seventh Civilization)】

【Seventh Civilization, liesun calendar Year 460: The scouring of the flood made it difficult for us to find these tablets. Through research, we have confirmed that there were indeed six civilizations before us, and all of them have been destroyed.

After another thirty years of debate, it was finally decided to leave a mark on this tablet.

Because of the chaos that ensued after the Sixth Civilization discovered the tablet, we have not made the tablet public. The populace remains in ignorance.】

【liesun calendar Year 609: The information on the tablet was made public, and the populace fell into chaos. Some people are loudly proclaiming that the destruction of previous civilizations was due to disrespecting the gods. Even we fell into deep doubt when we received this news.

A civilization destroyed every thousand years, and a destruction process that repeats every two thousand years—could there really be a high and mighty god looking down upon us?】

【liesun calendar Year 703: We have already begun moving from the surface into the underground. A large number of people have begun to believe in the divine cult mentioned above.】

【liesun calendar Year 709: After years of research, we have finally confirmed one thing: our civilization is deformed and artificially manipulated.

A normal civilization's evolution takes at least tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands of years, to slowly evolve intelligence and its own culture.

But the information we obtained from this Tablet of Destiny indicates that from the destruction of one civilization to the rise of a second civilization with different races and genes, no more than a thousand years pass.

Even this civilization develops rapidly over the next thousand years. Although this was true for the six civilizations before us, we still do not believe it is normal. Could there really be a god in the infinite universe watching us?】

【New liesun calendar Year 6: The Liesun people who disrespected the gods have been wiped out. We are believers in God. As long as we believe in the gods, the meteors will not fall! O great God of Creation and Destruction, we are your most devout believers.】

【Those who disrespect the gods will ultimately be destroyed!】

After reading the translated information from the tablet, there was a moment of silence in the room, so quiet that a pin could be heard dropping.

Although they had long ago discovered in countless historical ruins that they were not the only civilization on this planet.

But they never expected that seven civilizations with different cultures, different thoughts, and even different races had already appeared on this planet, and each had existed for a thousand years!



#3 Discover the traverser!


Chapter 3: Traveler Discovered!

Chapter 3

In the middle of the night, Su Mo slowly opened his eyes. After his stomach let out a growl, he touched his belly and got up to walk to the kitchen.

He didn't really care about what was happening inside the Little Universe.

Or rather, he didn't care right now.

When he first obtained this ability, Su Mo had actually been very concerned about the people within the Little Universe.

During the first two days, he had even reached the point of observing them at every moment.

However, with one day in the heavens being a thousand years in the mortal realm, he gradually grew bored after seeing too many of the various partings, reunions, joys, and sorrows within the Little Universe.

The most important point was that these races were basically not human, which left him with very little sense of immersion.

He made himself a barely passable dinner in the kitchen. By the time he finished eating, it was already eight o'clock in the evening.

After washing the dishes, he lay back on the bed and checked the remaining balance of over three thousand yuan on his bank card.

He thought to himself that as long as he destroyed the world tomorrow and raised his god rank to Level 3.5, he would be able to create some small gadgets in the real world.

For example, cash, gold, diamonds, and so on.

After thinking about it, it was better not to create cash. No matter how realistic you made cash, as long as it wasn't recorded by the state, it was counterfeit.

Using too much of it would easily attract the government's attention, so it would be better to just make some gold to exchange for money.

When that time came, he could finally live a life that somewhat resembled that of a God of Creation.

At the very least, a God of Creation like me shouldn't have to wash my own dishes and cook my own food.

With such thoughts, Su Mo dazed off and fell asleep once again.

By this time, five hundred years had passed in the Little Universe. Half of the time until the thousand-year apocalypse had already elapsed.

During this period, the information on the Tablet of Destiny had still been leaked.

The New Humans had split into two extremes. One faction, led by Otto V, was proactive and constantly building their sanctuary—the Undersea Castle!

They believed that the main reason the Sixth Civilization failed was that those floods were not normal floods.

If they were facing an ordinary flood, that method would indeed have been correct. However, this was an apocalyptic flood descending from the heavens.

The higher the elevation, the more impact from the flood one would endure.

They couldn't even imagine the terrifying impact force of an apocalyptic flood pouring down from the universe.

Even though the people of the Sixth Civilization had made plans and hidden in caves, according to their calculations, when that terrifying flood actually struck, it would be no different from a meteor strike.

The high mountain peaks and the soil they had piled up were simply unable to withstand that terrifying pressure.

This was the conclusion they all reached, but they actually had another conclusion they didn't dare speak aloud: those floods were man-made.

The creator could make them as large as they wanted. If they truly wanted to destroy them, whatever they did would be in vain.

However, no one dared to voice such a thought because they were afraid—afraid that if they said it, they would end up like the people outside who had chosen to give up and wallow in despair.

Because the third eye of the Three-Eyed Race allowed for rapid communication and information transfer.

After years of evolution and development, they could even use the third eye to link with others' brains, using them as computing power to achieve a controlled technological explosion. The more biological brains gathered, the stronger the computing power became. This was the most primitive biological computer.

The other faction chose to indulge themselves, racing cars, drinking heavily, and fighting every day. This Indulgence Faction wasn't exactly just being indulgent; they had surrendered most of their brain's computing power to the civilization.

In just these short two hundred years, they relied on this method of controlled technological explosion to continuously develop technology, jumping from a steam civilization straight into the technological era.

Due to these two extreme factions, the world was filled with a cyberpunk style.

Inside giant fortresses that were already beginning to take shape, countless skyscrapers stood tall. In the streets and alleys, members of the Indulgence Faction, dressed flamboyantly with multi-colored hair, drank, raced, and fought...

In the Otto Imperial Palace, a new meeting was underway. They were all the various leaders of the current Activist Faction.

Otto V sat at the head of the table and spoke slowly to those below: "Today is another decennial summary meeting. Everyone is free to speak their mind. By the way, First Generation, what stage has the construction of the Undersea Fortress reached?"

In the second position of the deputies, an ordinary-looking man slowly stood up: "Currently, the first two fortresses where construction began have been completed. I am confident that the remaining 79 fortresses will be finished within the next three hundred years."

Otto V nodded and waved his hand slightly: "Good, I understand. If any of you have problems in your respective projects, you can bring them up today, and we will solve them together."

The scene fell silent for a moment before a man with a large amount of red skin slowly stood up: "I propose the activation of the Alter Eye and the Giant of Light Projects."

Everyone fell silent. They had already guessed this outcome before coming here.

When they actually heard the news, there was dread and fear in their hearts, but even more so, there was excitement!

Yes, excitement.

The Alter Eye, to put it simply, was a satellite—a satellite launched into space to observe the world.

But that was only its surface purpose. Its true purpose was to record the existence of God!

The publicly stated purpose for developing the Giant of Light was the fear that the impact of the apocalyptic flood falling from high altitude would be too great and destroy the fortresses. Thus, the Giant of Light could shatter the massive floods before they hit the ground to reduce the impact.

But the real goal was to capture God!

Being able to sit here meant they were the smartest, wisest, and most insane group of people in the entire civilization.

In the current civilization, madness wasn't limited to the thugs racing and fighting in the fortress streets; it also included these people standing at the very peak of civilization.

Zoffy's proposal received everyone's approval. The Giant of Light and Alter Eye Projects were launched simultaneously.

...

The crowing of a rooster woke Su Mo from a beautiful dream. He rolled over, saw that it was not even eight-thirty, and went back to sleep.

A car accident on the main road not far from his house sent a young man into a coma. When he opened his eyes again, what he saw was a world full of cyberpunk style.

While he was still in a state of confusion, a large number of Three-Eyed People were already quickly surrounding him.

This was because just moments ago, the biological brain of this Three-Eyed person had been forcibly occupied.

The reason they were able to discover this so quickly was that all of their brains were connected together.

Just now, this person had suddenly gone offline.

Among the Three-Eyed Race, no one could control someone else's biological brain except for the owner. Even the lending of part of their brain's computing power to the state was done with their consent through signed agreements.

Not even Otto V or anyone else could invade another person's brain and occupy their body while they were awake.

But now that this situation had occurred, a thought instantly burst into everyone's minds: God has appeared!

At the same time, Su Mo, who had just started to feel sleepy again, was instantly woken up once more by a series of urgent warning sounds in his mind.

【Warning, warning, Traveler detected!】

【Warning, warning, Traveler detected!】

Su Mo:???



#4 Entering the microcosm, Su Mo was shocked.


Chapter 4: Entering the microcosm, Su Mo was shocked.

To be honest, Su Mo was utterly bewildered at this moment.

What's going on? A Traveler detected!

Where did this Traveler come from?

No, what does a Traveler have to do with me?

Why is this idiotic system issuing a warning?

The reason for all these questions and bewilderment was that he had just woken up from sleep. Although his body was awake, his mind wasn't fully there yet.

A moment later, Su Mo, still lying in bed and somewhat dazed, abruptly sat up with a startled cry: "What the hell, a Traveler!"

"What's happening? Why is there a Traveler? Where did the Traveler come from? Where is the Traveler?"

First a surprised exclamation, then a flurry of questions, showcasing Su Mo's shock at the moment.

However, this simple system built by Su Mo seemed like an artificial idiot and did not answer his questions, merely continuing to report the appearance of the Traveler.

Su Mo's brows furrowed slightly. Only then did he fully awaken from his sleep and calm down.

A moment later, he appeared directly in the Little Universe, and couldn't help but be stunned by the sight of the azure planet, the size of a basketball, not far away.

In just eight hundred years, this civilization, which had started from nothing, had already reached the level of a Tier 1 civilization, like Earth, possessing the ability to resist over ninety percent of natural disasters on their home planet. How could Su Mo not be shocked?

One must know that the previous seven civilizations, let alone reaching the brink of a Tier 1 civilization in eight hundred years, some of the worse ones hadn't even reached a Tier 0.5 civilization.

Moreover, looking at them now, it seems they have already begun to develop the aerospace field and are starting to explore the threshold of a Tier 2 civilization.

If they continue at this development speed, they won't need a thousand years, perhaps even five hundred years, to be able to survive off their home planet and become a true Tier 2 civilization.

This is simply outrageous! It's like the mother of outrageous opened the door for outrageous, utterly outrageous!

Shaking his head, he cast aside all the messy thoughts in his mind. He hadn't forgotten the purpose of entering the Little Universe this time; the Traveler was the top priority.

Everything else was just fleeting. Let alone this civilization currently being a Tier 1 civilization, even if it truly became a Tier 2 civilization, if he wanted to, he could still instantly destroy it.

Su Mo frowned and carefully observed the planet, but after a glance, he found no anomalies.

But that's right. In the short time from him waking up to entering the Little Universe, over half a month had already passed in the Little Universe.

Even if there really was a Traveler, as long as he wasn't an idiot, he must have already hidden.

Su Mo waved his hand forward, and a scene began to appear before him, like a giant movie screen, but the image on the screen was rapidly rewinding.

Two seconds later, the rewind stopped, because he had already found the Traveler.

To be honest, if it weren't for the appearance of this Traveler, Su Mo would have wanted to rewind time back to when this civilization first appeared.

He wanted to see what was going on with this civilization, that it could reach the level of a Tier 1 civilization in such a short time.

But it was just curiosity. There are many ways for a civilization to rise quickly.

They might have found alien technology, or unearthed the ruins of a previous civilization, or even experienced a technological explosion. All sorts of reasons are possible.

But in Su Mo's Little Universe, only the latter two possibilities are true, because there is currently only one civilization in this Little Universe.

So, aliens are simply impossible. They could only have found the ruins of a previous civilization, and then experienced a series of technological explosions on top of that for this situation to occur.

Originally, such a thing would have been enough for Su Mo to take a look, but because of the Traveler's existence, none of that mattered anymore.

He just wanted to know what was going on with this Traveler!

Civilization evolution, Su Mo allowed for countless possibilities, but a Traveler was not within his permitted scope!

Su Mo, who had read many web novels, knew that normal Travelers usually came with a Golden Finger!

If it was just an ordinary Golden Finger, then it would be fine. If he destroyed the world, the Traveler would perish along with the civilization.

He was afraid that this person would have those incredibly powerful, unkillable, undying systems. Then, would he even want his Little Universe anymore?

If that were truly the case, even he, the God of Creation, could very likely be killed by this guy.

So, this was absolutely unacceptable, but for now, Su Mo still needed to see what abilities this guy had.

If he was easy to bully, he would directly destroy the world. If he wasn't, Su Mo planned to destroy this universe along with him. At worst, he would spend a little time creating a new Little Universe.

Twenty days ago in the Little Universe, afternoon.

Liu Dajun was instantly stunned the moment he arrived in this cyberpunk-style world. He then pinched his thigh, suspecting he was dreaming.

But, if he remembered correctly, he had just been driving. Did he die?

However, the pain in his thigh let him know that he wasn't dreaming.

But if he wasn't dreaming, what was going on? Did the underworld also adopt a cyberpunk style?

A series of questions popped into his mind. He looked down at his red hands. At first, he thought it was blood from the car crash and didn't pay attention.

But a moment later, he realized it wasn't blood, but his own skin!

Afterward, he felt all over his body and finally confirmed one thing: he had transmigrated.

But before he could fully recover from the shock of his transmigration, he was already surrounded by a group of unknown monsters with three eyes on their heads and red and white skin.

After surrounding him, these people did not attack him. They just circled him, continuously speaking in a language he couldn't understand.

At this moment, inside the Ultraman Empire research lab, Otto V, Zoffy, and the Original Ultraman, among others, all stared solemnly at the image transmitted through the Alter Eye, intently observing the facial expressions of the person whose brain was occupied.

Otto V: "Zoffy, what do you think?"

Zoffy: "From his actions, demeanor, and movements, I suspect he is not the God we hypothesized. Perhaps he is a life form from another civilization, or I even suspect the possibility of his brain short-circuiting is greater than the possibility of him being a God."

Original Ultraman: "Yes, if this is the God of Destruction we have always feared, then God is too laughable."

"He seems to not understand our language. Have someone try to connect to his biological brain now. No matter who he is, first attempt to communicate with him and inquire about the situation."

The message was quickly relayed. A moment later, Liu Dajun, still standing in place and surrounded, felt a strange consciousness surge into his brain.

"Outsider, who are you, and why do you occupy the brain of a citizen of our Ultraman Empire?"



#5 Civilized conversation


Chapter 5 Civilized Conversation

Even when suddenly surrounded by so many people, he was still comforting himself, suspecting it was due to the original owner of this body.

After all, among all the Traveler novels he had read, none had the protagonist discovered immediately after transmigrating.

Even if the Traveler protagonist encountered a crisis at the start of their transmigration, they could still resolve it with their intelligence and knowledge from their original world.

But what the heck was this? He had just transmigrated and was immediately surrounded by a group of people, asking why he was occupying their citizen's brain!

He was discovered and surrounded within two minutes of transmigrating!

They won't dissect me, will they!

Just as he was thinking this, the voice spoke again: "Don't worry, we won't dissect you. We just want to know your origin."

Liu Dajun was startled again. His brain was working so fast that cold sweat began to trickle down his forehead, and the third eye between his brows started blinking rapidly.

What's going on!

I clearly didn't say anything just now, so why does he know what I'm thinking!

Is this the legendary mind-reading!

No, isn't this a technological world? There shouldn't be such a thing!

"Everyone in our Ultraman Empire has their brains linked together, so it's not difficult for us to know what you're thinking.

However, if you continue to expend super-core computing power like this, you might experience brain death on the spot. We will also take necessary measures, so we hope you cooperate with us!"

Upon hearing this, Liu Dajun finally calmed down.

However, given the current situation, there was nothing he could do even if he didn't calm down.

Since the other party could know whatever he said or thought, it was better to talk to them properly.

Anyway, he couldn't resist now. The worst that could happen was death. He had already died once, so what was there to fear?

Even if it got worse, could the outcome be any worse than this?

With these thoughts, Liu Dajun was led to a building over thirty stories high, but those people didn't take him up. Instead, they went down about twenty stories.

He twisted and turned through many paths. Unable to understand the writing of this world, Liu Dajun didn't know where he was being taken.

Inside a technologically advanced room, three Three-Eyed People with deep red skin sat opposite him, connecting to Liu Dajun's brain consciousness to begin communication.

"Hello, outsider. My name is Mobius. I am the developer of the Ultraman Empire's Mind Net. Our King Otto is very interested in your existence, so would you mind introducing yourself?"

Although it was a question, Liu Dajun knew he had no right to refuse. He could only begin to answer internally: "My name is Liu Dajun. I'm from Earth, and I'm 26 years old."

Liu Dajun's words were transmitted through the mental network to the Ultraman Empire's highest laboratory.

Otto V: "Ask him what kind of place Earth is and how he got here."

Mobius nodded lightly, then a kind smile appeared on his lips as he spoke to Liu Dajun: "Hello, Liu Dajun, it's a pleasure to meet you here, but we still want to know how you came here and why you are occupying the brain of our Ultraman Empire citizen."

"I don't know! I was just driving, then I had a car accident, and when I woke up, I was here."

"What is a car?"

"A mode of transportation, something from our world."

"Then what is your purpose for coming here?"

Liu Dajun: "I don't know! I woke up here after my car accident. I don't know how I got here."

For the following period, both sides conversed, then fell into shock and silence.

#10 Intend!

A 2-level God of Creation truly possesses the might of a God of Creation, even in the real world.

#11 A new storm has emerged...

Real world.

#12 Nine hundred and ninety years!


Chapter 12 Nine hundred and ninety years!

If it weren't for the Mosquitoes' truly astonishing reproductive capacity, given how difficult it was for them to find food, plus the fact that every few years the Ultraman Empire would drive the Giant of Light to carry out large-scale encirclement and suppression with massive firepower, they would have long since gone extinct.

Where would I find small monsters later?

In the real world, they might be swatted to death, but they could still occasionally suck some blood.

Recently, Liu Dajun had increasingly felt that his mental state was off.

After recording all the Mosquitoes' habits and naming the Giant of Light in other fortresses, he was again assigned by Otto V to do record-keeping work.

Although with the current technology of the Ultraman Empire, let alone a mere flood, even if the entire Blue Star were submerged, they might be fine, his heart simply couldn't calm down.

Liu Dajun stood in front of a machine, and Otto V's words echoed in his mind:

"Liu Dajun, you have been with our Ultraman Empire for over one hundred and sixty years. Although our Ultraman Empire has accepted you, you are ultimately from another civilization.

If we overcome this world-ending crisis, this will become history. If we fail, then our Ultraman Civilization will still be the strongest among the previous seven civilizations!

We have not only reached the forefront of technology but also intersected with extraterrestrial civilizations, so..."

Liu Dajun wrote down all the history of the Ultraman Civilization in simplified Chinese characters, compiled it into a book, and after multiple revisions, finally replicated and printed it onto huge, hard meteorites.

Looking at the familiar yet unfamiliar Chinese characters before him, Liu Dajun felt his consciousness begin to waver again.

He had been in this world for over one hundred and ninety years. If he counted his previous age on Earth, he had lived for two hundred years.

Two hundred years! Before, this was something he couldn't even imagine. Let alone him, even the top billionaires on Earth might not be able to achieve it.

He wondered if his older brother had managed the company well after he left. Thankfully, he hadn't married back then, otherwise, he would have ruined that girl's life.

"Liu Dajun, zoning out again!"

Hearing the voice, Liu Dajun turned sharply and saw it was Otto V, quickly saying, "King Otto."

After a long silence, Otto V finally spoke, "After years of research, the reason you often fall into a daze has been found."

Hearing this, Liu Dajun was overjoyed and quickly said, "Ah, really? What exactly is wrong with me?

It used to be fine; I'd only zone out for half an hour or an hour, but recently I feel like I'm getting worse. Sometimes I can even zone out for an entire day.

Otherwise, if no one came looking for me, I wouldn't even know how to go home. If it weren't for surveillance, I wouldn't even know what happened afterward."

Otto V silently watched the excited Liu Dajun before him. He seemed happy that the cause of his daze was about to be cured, but...

Seeing Otto V remain silent, Liu Dajun asked, "King, what's wrong? Is my mental problem very serious? It's fine, just tell me. I can accept it; I'm used to it anyway."

Otto V suddenly smiled, then shook his head, "No, it's not serious. In fact, it's good news for you."

"Good news? King, don't joke. Given this situation, what good news could there be? Just tell me directly; I can accept it."

Otto V didn't answer the question, instead changing the subject, "Do you know why I wanted you to compile the history of the Ultraman Empire and have you write and record it using the language of your original world?"

Hearing this, Liu Dajun was even more confused, unsure what was going on with Otto V, but he still replied, "Didn't you say that recording it from the perspective of Earth Civilization would make things more objective and real?"

Otto V continued to shake his head, "Actually, at that time, we had already discovered the problem with you, which is why we arranged for you to do such a thing."

Liu Dajun also felt something was wrong now, his eyebrows furrowing involuntarily. He felt a faint unease, as if Otto V was about to reveal some shocking news.

Otto V reached out and gently patted Liu Dajun's shoulder, seemingly comforting him, and a kind smile reappeared on his face:

"Don't worry, this is a good thing for you. The reason you are experiencing this is because your original body is calling out to your consciousness, or in your words, pulling your soul. You are about to return to your original world."


#13 The destruction of the world begins, the army of monsters!

Liu Dajun shook his head frantically, his face filled with disbelief, yet for some reason, he already felt a hint of conviction deep down.

At first, he thought it was just the use of simplified characters that made him recall his days on Earth.

It was an arm, a God’s arm!

It had suddenly appeared on the outskirts of Blue Star half a month after he arrived in this world, glanced at Blue Star, and then left.

At the time, they didn’t think much of it, but combining Otto V’s words with all the previous coincidences, he understood: God had always been there, and had always been watching them.

“Even if… even if all of this was created by that God, but, but why do you say our civilization cannot survive the great flood? This is clearly…”

“I also hope I’m overthinking it, but these things combined make me unable to help but overthink, so, I hope you…”

…

The conversation between the two lasted for a long time, and Su Mo watched with great interest.

Regarding Otto V’s deduction, he could only say that this guy indeed had some insight, but sometimes, knowing too much was not a good thing.

At the same time, he also felt that he himself had many shortcomings; as a God, a God of creation and destruction, he was actually discovered by mere mortals.

#14 Two choices!


Chapter 14: Two Choices!

Chapter 14

Although the previous Kaiju invasion incident allowed the technology of the Ultraman Empire to experience explosive growth once again, it also cost them more time.

Ordinary citizens had now all entered the fortresses, and in order not to burden the nation and even to make greater contributions, they chose to seal themselves inside Cryogenic Pods.

There were three such protective layers, and if all three layers were breached, the fortress would be destroyed by the flood.

Zoffy stood beside him and advised, "Your Majesty, you haven't closed your eyes for seven days. Why don't you rest? We will arrange for people to check everything."

#15 I am a sinner of civilization!

What's going on!

#16 Extraordinary item, Tears of Despair!
